results.summary:
Publish-readiness audit done. Added LICENSE (MIT — the license field had been claiming MIT with no file behind it) and listed it in package.json `files`. Filled in author/homepage/bugs, added `github-issues` and `cli` keywords, and set publishConfig {access: "public", provenance: true} so provenance is a property of the package rather than of one workflow's flags — #53 gets attestation even from a plain `npm publish`, and passing --provenance explicitly agrees with it rather than conflicting.

Deliberately did NOT add .npmignore: `files` is already an exact allowlist, so an ignore file would be a second source of truth that can only drift.

`files` itself needed no change — every runtime read is inside it: init.js reads skills/kanban + templates/** + bin/hkb.js, mcp.js reads templates/mcp/*, serve.js reads web/index.html, dispatch.js reads bin/hkb.js, cli.js reads package.json for --version, and .claude-plugin/plugin.json points at ./skills and ./hooks/hooks.json. The tarball is 41 files / 149.6 kB packed / 463.5 kB unpacked, exactly the tracked files under bin src web skills hooks templates .claude-plugin plus package.json, README.md, LICENSE — no test/, docs/, .kanban/ or .github/. Both executables (bin/hkb.js, skills/kanban/scripts/hkb) are mode 100755 in the git index.

KEY FACT for the rest of the track: the npm name `hkb` is unclaimed — `npm view hkb` returns E404 — so no rename is needed and `npx hkb` is ours to take.

Draft PR #56 on branch kb/52, based on main.
